stages.effectText: Deals Arts damage to 2 targets; when skill is active, attacks instead restore the HP of 2 allies (heal amount is equal to 75% of ATK)
Other allies within Attack Range with current HP percentage less than or equal to Perfumer the Distilled's gain 18% Sanctuary
Other allies within Attack Range with current HP percentage less than or equal to Perfumer the Distilled's gain 20% Sanctuary
